newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: COLOMBIAN REBELS ATTACK BP CONTRACTOR.
newsitem.headline: COLOMBIAN REBELS ATTACK BP CONTRACTOR.

text.p: Leftist guerrillas destroyed $2 million of construction equipment in an attack on a contract company working for British Petroleum Co Plc in eastern Colombia, police said Thursday.
The raid on the facilities of road builder Conconcreto took place late Wednesday near the town of Yopal, in Casanare province, where BP's Colombian oil operations are based.
Conconcreto was repairing a road that links Yopal with some of BP's wells.

Construction work at BP's Cupiagua field, also in Casanare, was halted for several weeks in June after National Liberation Army (ELN) rebels threatened to kill those contractors who defied guerrilla orders not to turn up for work.

The ELN has also paralyzed production at the Cano Limon field, in northeast Arauca province, after it carried out back- to-back dynamite attacks on the main pipeline that pumps crude to the oil terminal at the Caribbean port of Covenas.
The field was shut in Monday and at least 1 million barrels in crude exports from Covenas have been suspended.
